validation: Reviewed the complete P2 range 02b136ea8be82fe487b89360d788378a44ee0b7e..5449784ecff669914a68ed0e283e30db76ef5849 against the authoritative-player acceptance boundary.
Confirmed player identity is allocated from the world-global entity sequence, registered in the entity directory, persisted in the world manifest and restored before entity-directory verification.
Confirmed player inventory is authoritative world state and coarse semantic location is SimulationScopeId; no render coordinates or P3 place/travel semantics entered P2.
Confirmed AddPlayerActor is journaled as a world input and replay allocates/validates the same player identity.
Confirmed the Godot player presentation does not own WorldPlayer state or inventory and GameWorldSession reads the player projection from WorldRuntime.
Confirmed resident migration safely rejects the player as RESIDENT_NOT_FOUND without moving player state.
Exact-SHA CI snapshot showed scope success, core failure, Godot skipped and ci-required failure.

Inspected only failed core job 95329404226. Build failed with CA1859 in WorldRuntime.Player.cs because CanonicalPlayerInventory returns IReadOnlyList although Array.AsReadOnly provides a concrete ReadOnlyCollection.

Static review also identified a nullable-flow risk in the AddPlayerActor replay case because entry.AddPlayerActor is dereferenced again after a separate null-forgiving access under Nullable=enable and TreatWarningsAsErrors=true.
systems_examined: resident migration interaction with player entity IDs
core and Godot CI dependency chain

findings.summary: WorldRuntime.Player.CanonicalPlayerInventory returns IReadOnlyList<WorldPlayerInventoryItemState>; latest-recommended analyzer CA1859 is promoted to an error. Return the concrete ReadOnlyCollection produced by Array.AsReadOnly.

The AddPlayerActor replay branch uses entry.AddPlayerActor! for ScopeId but dereferences entry.AddPlayerActor again for CreatedPlayerId. Bind the validated payload to a local non-null variable so nullable-flow analysis cannot fail after the CA1859 repair.

residual_risks: WorldRuntime ordinary tick/command full-state staging remains intentionally deferred to P4.
Player semantic location is deliberately coarse SimulationScopeId only; finer AtPlace/Travelling semantics belong to P3.

World manifest Player is additive/optional without a world version bump; current persistence/replay compatibility is covered, while formal cross-version migration policy remains future work if the world schema must support older binaries reading new saves.
The feature branch remains unprotected server-side; enforcement is repository/CI/agent based.
